rationale: The headline claim—picosecond-scale octupole relaxation (~10 ps) in the low-barrier regime—is robustly reproduced via three independent methods (analytic, Monte-Carlo, Langevin), yielding τ ≈ 6–13 ps matching the paper's stated scale. The two-mechanism crossover (dephasing ps vs escape ns) is confirmed. A ~2× prefactor ambiguity vs the paper's Eq. 10 remains from normalization conventions but does not affect the physical scale. Coverage is limited because the full six-spin s-LLG and electrical tunability (SOT) were not exercised, and material parameters were adopted rather than derived.
